items.source: This Getting Started guide walks you through deploying your Spring Boot application to either Azure Spring Cloud or Azure App Service.
items.translation: 本入门指南将指导您将 Spring Boot 应用程序部署到 Azure Spring Cloud 或 Azure App Service。

items.source: Spring Boot’s executable jars are ready-made for most popular cloud PaaS (Platform-as-a-Service) providers. These providers tend to require that you “bring your own container”. They manage application processes (not Java applications specifically), so they need an intermediary layer that adapts your application to the cloud’s notion of a running process.
items.translation: Spring Boot 的可执行 JAR 文件已针对大多数流行的云 PaaS（平台即服务）提供商进行了优化。这些提供商通常要求您“自带容器”。它们管理应用程序进程（而不仅仅是 Java 应用程序），因此需要一个中间层，将 您的 应用程序适配到 云 对运行进程的定义中。

items.source: Two popular cloud providers, Heroku and Cloud Foundry, employ a “buildpack” approach. The buildpack wraps your deployed code in whatever is needed to start your application. It might be a JDK and a call to java, an embedded web server, or a full-fledged application server. A buildpack is pluggable, but ideally you should be able to get by with as few customizations to it as possible. This reduces the footprint of functionality that is not under your control. It minimizes divergence between development and production environments.
items.translation: 两个流行的云提供商 Heroku 和 Cloud Foundry 采用了“构建包（buildpack）”方法。构建包将您部署的代码包裹起来，提供启动应用程序所需的一切。它可能包括 JDK 和对 `java` 的调用、嵌入式 Web 服务器，或是一个完整的应用服务器。构建包是可插拔的，但理想情况下，您应尽可能减少对其的自定义。这减少了不受您控制的功能的占用空间，并最大限度地减少了开发与生产环境之间的差异。

items.source: Cloud Foundry provides default buildpacks that come into play if no other buildpack is specified. The Cloud Foundry Java buildpack has excellent support for Spring applications, including Spring Boot. You can deploy stand-alone executable jar applications as well as traditional .war packaged applications.
items.translation: Cloud Foundry 提供默认构建包，如果未指定其他构建包，则使用这些默认构建包。 Cloud Foundry Java 构建包 对 Spring 应用程序（包括 Spring Boot）提供了出色的支持。 您可以部署独立的可执行 jar 应用程序以及传统的.war打包应用程序。

items.source: CloudCaptain works by turning your Spring Boot executable jar or war into a minimal VM image that can be deployed unchanged either on VirtualBox or on AWS. CloudCaptain leverages this information both for the images it produces as well as for all the resources it provisions (instances, security groups, elastic load balancers, and so on).

items.source:
When Kubernetes deletes an application instance, the shutdown process involves several subsystems concurrently: shutdown hooks, unregistering the service, removing the instance from the load-balancer…​
Because this shutdown processing happens in parallel (and due to the nature of distributed systems), there is a window during which traffic can be routed to a pod that has also begun its shutdown processing.
items.translation: 当 Kubernetes 删除应用程序实例时，关闭过程涉及多个子系统并发执行：关闭钩子、注销服务、从负载均衡器中移除实例……由于此关闭处理是并行执行的（且分布式系统的特性所致），存在一个时间窗口，在此期间流量可能会被路由到已开始关闭处理的 Pod。

items.source:
You can configure a sleep execution in a preStop handler to avoid requests being routed to a pod that has already begun shutting down.
This sleep should be long enough for new requests to stop being routed to the pod and its duration will vary from deployment to deployment.
items.translation: 您可以在 `preStop` 处理器中配置睡眠执行，以避免请求被路由到已经开始关闭的 Pod。该睡眠时间应足够长，以确保不再有新请求被路由到该 Pod，且其持续时间因部署而异。

items.source: When Kubernetes sends a SIGTERM signal to the pod, it waits for a specified time called the termination grace period (the default for which is 30 seconds). If the containers are still running after the grace period, they are sent the SIGKILL signal and forcibly removed. If the pod takes longer than 30 seconds to shut down, which could be because you have increased spring.lifecycle.timeout-per-shutdown-phase, make sure to increase the termination grace period by setting the terminationGracePeriodSeconds option in the Pod YAML.
items.translation: 当 Kubernetes 向 Pod 发送 SIGTERM 信号时，它会等待一段指定的时间，称为终止宽限期（默认值为 30 秒）。 如果宽限期过后容器仍在运行，它们将收到 SIGKILL 信号并被强制移除。 如果 Pod 的关闭时间超过 30 秒（这可能是因为你增加了 spring.lifecycle.timeout-per-shutdown-phase`），请确保通过设置 Pod YAML 中的 terminationGracePeriodSeconds 选项来增加终止宽限期。
